svg.title: APS Service-to-Billing Flow
svg.desc: Editable vector flowchart for an independent SAP Service Management simulation based on the UCI Scania APS dataset. All graphical elements are SVG vectors.

g.text: Traceability from dataset signal to billing review, including operational exceptions.
Data: UCI Scania APS Failure Dataset
Customer, asset, and transactions are simulated.
Monetary values in IDR · Simulation only
